title: Mass scales by ρ^k under dilation
statement: Mass scaling under dilation. Let N ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, k ∈ ℕ, and let X, Y ∈ D_k(ℝ^N) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k on Eucl N). Suppose Y(ω) = X(η) for all test k-forms ω, η (TestFormOn univ k) with η(x) = ρ^k ω(ρx) for all x. Then M(Y) = ρ^k M(X) in [0, ∞], i.e. Y.mass = ENNReal.ofReal(ρ^k) · X.mass.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x = ρ ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) (ρ • x)) → Y ω = X η) → Y.mass = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k) * X.mass
